identity: Observed participant public key; neither an authenticated grant nor stock authority
crypto: Bounded NIP-44 v2 primitives; executor authenticates carriers and applies stricter profile budgets
plaintext_ownership: Bounded before copying; owned buffers zeroized on drop; no Clone or serialization; constant redacted Debug
nonce_entropy: Explicit injected CSPRNG capability; trait and returned array supply no entropy qualification
native_nonce_transcription: Exactly one 32-byte request into pinned codec RngCore; no CryptoRng claim; changed consumption refused before output

native_backend.scope: Existing original-length codec within smaller Radroots profile limits; no extended-length capability claim

admission: Freeze expected provider identity and explicit deadline; reject cancelled/expired/mismatched calls before effects
obtained_results: No post-effect deadline/cancellation check discards a returned result; executor retains preimages before signing
signing_replay: Identity-scoped observation; never overrides retained unknown state or permits blind reissue
remaining: Complete private chat and binding workflows
